hints: The phrase 'must be built starting from this center s' is what forces Prim rather than Kruskal.
Keep two matrices: the input weights, and a separate output matrix initialised to 0 on the diagonal and -1 everywhere else.
Fill the output matrix from parent[]: for every v except s, tree[parent[v]][v] = tree[v][parent[v]] = w. If any parent is still -1, that vertex was unreachable - print -1 and nothing else.
